plan.summary:
`joinPath` now trims each path segment before it drops empty segments and joins them with `/`. Segments such as `" a "` and `"a"` now give the same result, and whitespace-only segments are removed.

- `src/paths.ts`: adds a `trim()` step in `joinPath`.
- `tests/paths.test.ts`: new test for the trimming rule.
- `package.json`: adds the new test file to the `test` script.
plan.riskRationale: This is a small change to one pure function. A new test covers it. Callers that relied on untrimmed segments with spaces will see different output.
plan.storyArc: The fix changes `joinPath` so that it trims segments first. A new test shows the rule. The `test` script change makes the test run in `npm test`.

topics.title: Trim segments in joinPath
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `joinPath` treat whitespace in segments now? Connect the new `map` trim step to the test case (`' a '`, `'b'`, `'  '` gives `'a/b'`) and to the `package.json` script entry that runs the test. Check that the trim happens before the `filter(Boolean)` step, so whitespace-only segments are removed.
